map.写作、论文或社媒文案发布前，统计总字符数与中英文单词数，确认是否满足字数限制（如: Before publishing writing, a paper or social-media copy, count the total characters and Chinese-English word counts to confirm whether word limits are met (such as abstract length, platform caps).
map.对比字符数（含空白）与（不含空白），排查多余空格与不可见字符，保证排版与计费准确: Compare character count (with whitespace) and (without whitespace) to find extra spaces and invisible characters, ensuring accurate layout and billing.
map.按行数与非空行数快速估算代码、清单或名单的条目规模。: Quickly estimate the item scale of code, lists or rosters by line count and non-empty line count.
map.文本「这是一段示例，Hello World 2026！」：总字符（含空白）22、: Text "This is a sample, Hello World 2026!": total characters (with whitespace) 22, without whitespace 19, Chinese characters 8, English words 2 (Hello / World), digit groups 1 (2026), lines 1, non-empty lines 1.
map.按连续字母串识别（如 Hello、World 各算 1 个），连字符与缩写内的字: Identified by continuous letter strings (e.g. Hello, World each count as 1); hyphens and letters inside abbreviations are merged into the same word; Chinese is counted
map.汉字逐字计数，标点与空白不计入中文字数。: character by character, and punctuation and whitespace are not counted as Chinese characters.
map.数字计入「总字符数」与「数字组数」，但不计入中文字符数或英文单词数；连续数字（如: Digits are counted in "total characters" and "digit groups" but not in Chinese character count or English word count; continuous digits (such as 2026) count as one digit group, not 4 English words.
